==About==

A Witch's Hat is a Poisonous Mushroom which can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Witch's Hat}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Witch's Hat there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Witch's Hat can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.

When boiled a Witch's Hat will become a {{i|Boiled Witch's Hat}}. Both a Boiled Witch's Hat and a Witch's Hat count as a Witch's Hat when planting and in Food recipes.
